svg.title: Additional received bytes and observations with a gain
svg.desc: 402192 bytes in additional PDUs minus 1056 bytes in missed PDUs equals 401136 net extra bytes. Headers included, FCS excluded; not application-only bytes. 141 of 266 observations have an added packet. The grid groups outcomes, not time; these are not independent trials.

g.text: Additional data, with losses accounted for.
Bytes in observation-level PDUs · headers included · FCS excluded
One square = one observation. Grouped by outcome, not time; gains can coexist with losses.
PDU bytes are not application-only measurements or globally unique telemetry.
